episodes.title: Episode 1
episodes.summary: Tasha & Jack's anniversary dinner is interrupted by Jen. When Tasha is awkwardly reminded of Jen's close ties to Jack's family, fear leads her to ask Jack to cut contact with Jen.

episodes.title: Episode 2
episodes.summary: As Jen remains firmly in the peripheries of Jack and Tasha's family life, Tasha spirals into paranoia as she comes to believe that, rather than her husband, Jen is actually after her daughter. Her worst fears are realised when Emily disappears.

episodes.title: Episode 3
episodes.summary: Desperate to get her daughter back, Tasha will do anything to get to the truth, even if that means accepting an offer of help from an unlikely source in Jen. As they track down Jack, the reality of Tasha's marriage is finally exposed.

episodes.title: Episode 4
episodes.summary: As Jen is faced with an uncomfortable choice, Tasha's mission to be reunited with her daughter pushes her to further extremes. When a motorway accident leaves some battling for survival, others escape to a new life, free of the past.

episodes.title: Episode 1
episodes.summary: Following her dramatic car accident, Tasha is hiding out in Cyprus with her daughter. Jack - now released from prison - is searching for Tasha and for redemption from his ex-wife, Jen.

episodes.title: Episode 2
episodes.summary: Tasha makes a friend, while Jack manipulates Jen into revealing secrets.

episodes.title: Episode 3
episodes.summary: As Jack hunts for Tasha in Cyprus, he comes closer to learning the truth.

episodes.title: Episode 4
episodes.summary: Jack is on the warpath and Jen attempts to warn Tasha, but she's too late.
